profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Adobe · Platform & SDK Engineering · AI-Native / Agentic Development (TypeScript · Node · React)
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Adobe building the developer platforms and SDKs that bring personalization and growth experiences to tens of millions of Creative Cloud users across desktop, mobile, and web.

I work end-to-end — TypeScript/Node API surfaces with code generation over a native C++ core, React + Spectrum configuration UIs, multi-architecture npm distribution (Node.js + WASM), and CI/CD modernization — and I'm currently the front-end lead on a greenfield event-telemetry and data-governance platform.

My recent focus is AI-native engineering: building real systems with agent-assisted workflows and the discipline to make them reliable — evals, enforcement gates, architecture decision records, coverage gates. I authored an Agentic Software Development Lifecycle now being piloted by my org.

Stack: TypeScript · Node.js · React · C++ (interop) · Adobe Experience Platform · App Builder · GitHub Actions. Earlier: native iOS/tvOS and cross-platform mobile at Comcast NBCUniversal.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a multi-surface campaign simulation tool end-to-end that lets growth marketers validate campaign behavior against synthetic user profiles, test events, and contextual attributes before touching production — surface selection, campaign view, test-profile management, a synthetic-events API, shareable result URLs, sandbox switching, and a live content-preview browser extension.
- Designed and published an Agentic SDLC for my org: a 6-phase development loop with tiered contribution lanes and an 8-layer assurance model (rules, pre-commit gates, architecture-enforcement tests, coverage gates, AI + human review, agentic QA, staged rollout). Presented to engineering leadership; now piloting.
- Front-end lead on a greenfield event-telemetry and data-governance platform — the org's primary current investment.
- Owned Photoshop in-app surface onboarding end-to-end: connected six surfaces to the personalization pipeline, working across the Photoshop product, growth, and content-configuration teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Founding engineer when my team was reconstituted to build a new growth SDK from scratch; established the tag-extension framework and configuration UI adopted by all Creative Cloud apps onboarding to it. Integrated it into Creative Cloud Desktop's background process — tens of millions of installs — building the full child-process lifecycle and resolving production-blocking Windows issues at ship.
- Designed and shipped the SDK's JavaScript/TypeScript API layer with automated code generation across the C++/Node.js boundary, eliminating type-drift bugs for every integrating team.
- Maintained and extended Adobe's dynamic paywall platform, shipping multi-plan paywall and in-app messaging templates across Creative Cloud apps (Fresco, Photoshop, Express, Rush, Acrobat) — adding features, configuring SKU/template content, and cutting versioned releases with CI and visual-regression coverage.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Implemented in-app purchases and tracking for anonymous workflows on iOS and tvOS, doubling monthly revenue.
- Developed features such as Chromecast integration, favoriting, and live streaming for 5+ mobile platforms.
- Redesigned the mobile application, increasing store ratings from 2.8 to 4.8+ stars.
- Developed features including Chromecast, session handling, favorites, and live-streaming.
- Managed 5+ mobile platforms independently and then with 1 other engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed user registration, file upload, and procurement workflows for a modernization project with 1,000+ users.
- Developed the procurement request views with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework.

positions.title: Techranger
positions.description:
- Developed an admin panel for UDOIT with PHP and SQL.
- Improved development environment setup and teardown with Docker.
